critical_code_review_comments: Employees.jsx line 20 reads session.access_token without null-check — if session is null (e.g., token expired right before action) it will throw. Defensive: const token = session?.access_token; if (!token) return toast.error('Sesi berakhir').

server.py NewEmployee uses plain str for email with a loose '@' + '.' check; intentional per note so '.test' domains pass, but normalization/trim and lowercasing would help avoid duplicate accounts (e.g., trailing spaces).

server.py reset_employee_password / delete_employee call Supabase admin API; failure branches collapse all errors into generic 400 — losing status/body makes debugging hard. Consider logging r.text and returning r.status_code when non-2xx.

Employees.jsx toggleActive updates profiles directly from client (RLS must allow owner update of is_active). This works but bypasses the FastAPI layer; if later RLS is tightened for profiles, the toggle will silently fail. Consider centralizing via /api/employees/{id} PATCH.

Row-level permission check `protectedRow` uses role === 'owner' || 'admin', while backend only enforces self-check (owner can't delete self). An owner could technically call DELETE /api/employees/{other_owner_id} and succeed — guard server-side too if multi-owner is possible.
